description: There exists a tree of height omega one with countable levels and no cofinal branch; every branch is countable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajn_exists :
  ∃ T,
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsAronszajnTree T (Cardinal.aleph 1) ∧
      (∀ a < Ordinal.omega 1, (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level T a).Countable) ∧
        ∀ (B : Set T.carrier), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsBranch T B → B.Countable
